The application keeps the"},{"line":92,"text":"original owner and diagnostics. Fixed wiring passes the intended instance's"},{"line":93,"text":"original references without introducing another identity registry."},{"line":94,"text":""},{"line":95,"text":"## Interpret observations accurately"},{"line":96,"text":""},{"line":97,"text":"| Observation | Meaning |"},{"line":98,"text":"|---|---|"},{"line":99,"text":"| Missing value or ERROR/INVALIDATE | No current usable fact on that port; do not retain the old displayed value |"},{"line":100,"text":"| Startup says started | The instance started; it does not prove authorization, success or run completion |"},{"line":101,"text":"| Assessment flags a transaction | The business condition is met; evidence and permission are still required |"},{"line":102,"text":"| Publication says succeeded | That exact request reports success in the simulated writer; other obligations and coverage remain separate |"},{"line":103,"text":"| Coverage/issues | Facts for their associated scope; the five latest port values are not an atomic snapshot |"},{"line":104,"text":"| Panel detach | Observation stops; the running instance retains outstanding obligations |"},{"line":105,"text":"| Application `runEndReady` / `inspect().normalEndReady` | Current graph/host readiness conditions, not proof that lifecycle termination or resource release occurred |"},{"line":106,"text":""},{"line":107,"text":"For integrators, this host supports at most 64 retained distinct request records"},{"line":108,"text":"per owned epoch, including refusals, and one in-flight write. An unknown or reconciliation-required outcome is not success or"},{"line":111,"text":"proof of no submission, and it prevents normal-end readiness. The application"},{"line":112,"text":"must preserve those records instead of treating panel cleanup as recovery."},{"line":113,"text":""},{"line":114,"text":"The ordinary panel does not poll diagnostics or claim that the whole run ended."},{"line":115,"text":"The protocol has no END message: business stop, node COMPLETE and run termination"},{"line":116,"text":"are distinct. An old"},{"line":136,"text":"receipt does not verify a new implementation. Fixed wiring passes the intended instance's"},{"line":93,"text":"original references without introducing another identity registry."},{"line":94,"text":""},{"line":95,"text":"## Interpret observations accurately"},{"line":96,"text":""},{"line":97,"text":"| Observation | Meaning |"},{"line":98,"text":"|---|---|"},{"line":99,"text":"| Missing value or ERROR/INVALIDATE | No current usable fact on that port; do not retain the old displayed value |"},{"line":100,"text":"| Startup says started | The instance started; it does not prove authorization, success or run completion |"},{"line":101,"text":"| Assessment flags a transaction | The business condition is met; evidence and permission are still required |"},{"line":102,"text":"| Publication says succeeded | That exact request reports success in the simulated writer; other obligations and coverage remain separate |"},{"line":103,"text":"| Coverage/issues | Facts for their associated scope; the five latest port values are not an atomic snapshot |"},{"line":104,"text":"| Panel detach | Observation stops; the running instance retains outstanding obligations |"},{"line":105,"text":"| Application `runEndReady` / `inspect().normalEndReady` | Current graph/host readiness conditions, not proof that lifecycle termination or resource release occurred |"},{"line":106,"text":""},{"line":107,"text":"For integrators, this host supports at most 64 retained distinct request records"},{"line":108,"text":"per owned epoch, including refusals, and one in-flight write. Distinct instances use distinct names, input Nodes and"},{"line":86,"text":"resource bindings. A name is not an authorization token."},{"line":87,"text":""},{"line":88,"text":"Display components receive only the original `.view`; frameworks pass the original"},{"line":89,"text":"identity/execution/retained capabilities; maintainers inspect the same Graph."},{"line":90,"text":"Showing an identity subset does not remove lifecycle or retained-evidence nodes."},{"line":91,"text":"Capabilities have no arbitrary I/O execution method. The application keeps the"},{"line":92,"text":"original owner and diagnostics. Fixed wiring passes the intended instance's"},{"line":93,"text":"original references without introducing another identity registry."},{"line":94,"text":""},{"line":95,"text":"## Interpret observations accurately"},{"line":96,"text":""},{"line":97,"text":"| Observation | Meaning |"},{"line":98,"text":"|---|---|"},{"line":99,"text":"| Missing value or ERROR/INVALIDATE | No current usable fact on that port; do not retain the old displayed value |"},{"line":100,"text":"| Startup says started | The instance started; it does not prove authorization, success or run completion |"},{"line":101,"text":"| Assessment flags a transaction | The business condition is met; evidence and permission are still required |"},{"line":102,"text":"| Publication says succeeded | That exact request reports success in the simulated writer; other obligations and coverage remain separate |"},{"line":103,"text":"| Coverage/issues | Facts for their associated scope; the five latest port values are not an atomic snapshot |"},{"line":104,"text":"| Panel detach | Observation stops; the running instance retains outstanding obligations |"},{"line":105,"text":"| Application `runEndReady` / `inspect().normalEndReady` | Current graph/host readiness conditions, not proof that lifecycle termination or resource release occurred |"},{"line":106,"text":""},{"line":107,"text":"For integrators, this host supports at most 64 retained distinct request records"},{"line":108,"text":"per owned epoch, including refusals, and one in-flight write. A busy or exhausted"},{"line":109,"text":"write budget produces an exact cancelled/no-submit result; there is no queue or"},{"line":110,"text":"automatic retry. An unknown or reconciliation-required outcome is not success or"},{"line":111,"text":"proof of no submission, and it prevents normal-end readiness. The application"},{"line":112,"text":"must preserve those records instead of treating panel cleanup as recovery."},{"line":113,"text":""},{"line":114,"text":"The ordinary panel does not poll diagnostics or claim that the whole run ended."},{"line":115,"text":"The protocol has no END message: business stop, node COMPLETE and run termination"},{"line":116,"text":"are distinct. Retention remains bounded by the existing contract, not by whether"},{"line":117,"text":"someone is viewing the graph. The demo's final forced test cleanup does not prove"},{"line":118,"text":"normal lifecycle completion."},{"line":119,"text":""},{"line":120,"text":"The private value binding clears stale values on INVALIDATE and ERROR. The existing"},{"line":121,"text":"public `subscribeNodeValues` adapter currently ignores INVALIDATE, so it is not a"},{"line":122,"text":"direct substitute for this particular view contract."},{"line":123,"text":""},{"line":124,"text":"## Inspect code changes and evidence"},{"line":125,"text":""},{"line":126,"text":"Follow the actual request, admission and outcome references in the demo output to"},{"line":127,"text":"the running graph. Then distinguish these three questions:"},{"line":128,"text":""},{"line":129,"text":"| Question | Evidence required |"},{"line":130,"text":"|---|---|"},{"line":131,"text":"| Did this node's implementation change despite unchanged ID/edges? | Revision-bound source mapping within its declared coverage |"},{"line":132,"text":"| Who changed it? | Separate provenance; an implementation digest alone gives no attribution |"},{"line":133,"text":"| Which consequences remain unchanged? | Independent verification bound to the current revision and inputs |"},{"line":134,"text":""},{"line":135,"text":"Missing source binding means uncovered; missing provenance means unknown. An old"},{"line":136,"text":"receipt does not verify a new implementation. Existing bounded source-change and"},{"line":137,"text":"mutation evidence can be inspected in the [implementation review](../../docs/design/causal-graded-entry-implementation/README.md)."},{"line":138,"text":"Those retained artifacts describe their own revisions; the new demo does not"},{"line":139,"text":"requalify them or attest the loaded production source."},{"line":140,"text":""},{"line":141,"text":"The example and offline tests demonstrate available composition paths, not a"},{"line":142,"text":"human usability result or superiority to a complete plain-code host. B121's real"},{"line":143,"text":"inbox qualification, independent human/agent comparisons and aggregate acceptance"},{"line":144,"text":"remain separate."},{"line":145,"text":""}],"nextLine":null}]

Start with the object supplied to your component:"},{"line":31,"text":""},{"line":32,"text":"| You already have | Read this contract first | Read implementation details when |"},{"line":33,"text":"|---|---|---|"},{"line":34,"text":"| An existing `SpendingAlertsView` and a render callback | [`mountSpendingView`](causal-view-binding.ts): five latest port values, explicit `unavailable` ports, observation cleanup | You need a different observation policy; the [ordinary panel](causal-ordinary-panel.ts) shows a consumer |"},{"line":35,"text":"| A Graph and prepared creation inputs | [`spendingAlertsFor`](causal-entry.ts): immutable defaults, per-compose overrides and returned view/capabilities | You also own input preparation or the executing host; follow [inputs](causal-inputs.ts) or [host](causal-focused-host.ts) for those responsibilities |"},{"line":36,"text":"| Issued capabilities, their owning Graph and expected binding | [`assertCausalCapabilities`](../../packages/ts/src/solutions/causal-occurrence/capabilities.ts): issued-object, Graph, binding and lineage validation | You implement capability construction; the [role examples](causal-audience.examples.ts) show consumption |"},{"line":37,"text":"| The owning Graph and a running instance | `graph.describe()` for graph structure; the instance's `inspect()` for host state, documented in [host](causal-focused-host.ts) | You are tracing a specific readiness, admission or outcome dependency |"},{"line":38,"text":""},{"line":39,"text":"Using an existing view does not require reconstructing its input facts, permission"},{"line":40,"text":"sources or host. The application keeps the"},{"line":92,"text":"original owner and diagnostics. Fixed wiring passes the intended instance's"},{"line":93,"text":"original references without introducing another identity registry."},{"line":94,"text":""},{"line":95,"text":"## Interpret observations accurately"},{"line":96,"text":""},{"line":97,"text":"| Observation | Meaning |"},{"line":98,"text":"|---|---|"},{"line":99,"text":"| Missing value or ERROR/INVALIDATE | No current usable fact on that port; do not retain the old displayed value |"},{"line":100,"text":"| Startup says started | The instance started; it does not prove authorization, success or run completion |"},{"line":101,"text":"| Assessment flags a transaction | The business condition is met; evidence and permission are still required |"},{"line":102,"text":"| Publication says succeeded | That exact request reports success in the simulated writer; other obligations and coverage remain separate |"},{"line":103,"text":"| Coverage/issues | Facts for their associated scope; the five latest port values are not an atomic snapshot |"},{"line":104,"text":"| Panel detach | Observation stops; the running instance retains outstanding obligations |"},{"line":105,"text":"| Application `runEndReady` / `inspect().normalEndReady` | Current graph/host readiness conditions, not proof that lifecycle termination or resource release occurred |"},{"line":106,"text":""},{"line":107,"text":"For integrators, this host supports at most 64 retained distinct request records"},{"line":108,"text":"per owned epoch, including refusals, and one in-flight write. An unknown or reconciliation-required outcome is not success or"},{"line":111,"text":"proof of no submission, and it prevents normal-end readiness. The application"},{"line":112,"text":"must preserve those records instead of treating panel cleanup as recovery."},{"line":113,"text":""},{"line":114,"text":"The ordinary panel does not poll diagnostics or claim that the whole run ended."},{"line":115,"text":"The protocol has no END message: business stop, node COMPLETE and run termination"},{"line":116,"text":"are distinct. An old"},{"line":136,"text":"receipt does not verify a new implementation. A name is not an authorization token."},{"line":87,"text":""},{"line":88,"text":"Display components receive only the original `.view`; frameworks pass the original"},{"line":89,"text":"identity/execution/retained capabilities; maintainers inspect the same Graph."},{"line":90,"text":"Showing an identity subset does not remove lifecycle or retained-evidence nodes."},{"line":91,"text":"Capabilities have no arbitrary I/O execution method. The application keeps the"},{"line":92,"text":"original owner and diagnostics. Fixed wiring passes the intended instance's"},{"line":93,"text":"original references without introducing another identity registry."},{"line":94,"text":""},{"line":95,"text":"## Interpret observations accurately"},{"line":96,"text":""},{"line":97,"text":"| Observation | Meaning |"},{"line":98,"text":"|---|---|"},{"line":99,"text":"| Missing value or ERROR/INVALIDATE | No current usable fact on that port; do not retain the old displayed value |"},{"line":100,"text":"| Startup says started | The instance started; it does not prove authorization, success or run completion |"},{"line":101,"text":"| Assessment flags a transaction | The business condition is met; evidence and permission are still required |"},{"line":102,"text":"| Publication says succeeded | That exact request reports success in the simulated writer; other obligations and coverage remain separate |"},{"line":103,"text":"| Coverage/issues | Facts for their associated scope; the five latest port values are not an atomic snapshot |"},{"line":104,"text":"| Panel detach | Observation stops; the running instance retains outstanding obligations |"},{"line":105,"text":"| Application `runEndReady` / `inspect().normalEndReady` | Current graph/host readiness conditions, not proof that lifecycle termination or resource release occurred |"},{"line":106,"text":""},{"line":107,"text":"For integrators, this host supports at most 64 retained distinct request records"},{"line":108,"text":"per owned epoch, including refusals, and one in-flight write. A busy or exhausted"},{"line":109,"text":"write budget produces an exact cancelled/no-submit result; there is no queue or"},{"line":110,"text":"automatic retry. An unknown or reconciliation-required outcome is not success or"},{"line":111,"text":"proof of no submission, and it prevents normal-end readiness. The application"},{"line":112,"text":"must preserve those records instead of treating panel cleanup as recovery."},{"line":113,"text":""},{"line":114,"text":"The ordinary panel does not poll diagnostics or claim that the whole run ended."},{"line":115,"text":"The protocol has no END message: business stop, node COMPLETE and run termination"},{"line":116,"text":"are distinct. Retention remains bounded by the existing contract, not by whether"},{"line":117,"text":"someone is viewing the graph. The demo's final forced test cleanup does not prove"},{"line":118,"text":"normal lifecycle completion."},{"line":119,"text":""},{"line":120,"text":"The private value binding clears stale values on INVALIDATE and ERROR. The existing"},{"line":121,"text":"public `subscribeNodeValues` adapter currently ignores INVALIDATE, so it is not a"},{"line":122,"text":"direct substitute for this particular view contract."},{"line":123,"text":""},{"line":124,"text":"## Inspect code changes and evidence"},{"line":125,"text":""},{"line":126,"text":"Follow the actual request, admission and outcome references in the demo output to"},{"line":127,"text":"the running graph. Then distinguish these three questions:"},{"line":128,"text":""},{"line":129,"text":"| Question | Evidence required |"},{"line":130,"text":"|---|---|"},{"line":131,"text":"| Did this node's implementation change despite unchanged ID/edges? | Revision-bound source mapping within its declared coverage |"},{"line":132,"text":"| Who changed it? | Separate provenance; an implementation digest alone gives no attribution |"},{"line":133,"text":"| Which consequences remain unchanged? | Independent verification bound to the current revision and inputs |"},{"line":134,"text":""},{"line":135,"text":"Missing source binding means uncovered; missing provenance means unknown. An old"},{"line":136,"text":"receipt does not verify a new implementation. Existing bounded source-change and"},{"line":137,"text":"mutation evidence can be inspected in the [implementation review](../../docs/design/causal-graded-entry-implementation/README.md)."},{"line":138,"text":"Those retained artifacts describe their own revisions; the new demo does not"},{"line":139,"text":"requalify them or attest the loaded production source."},{"line":140,"text":""},{"line":141,"text":"The example and offline tests demonstrate available composition paths, not a"},{"line":142,"text":"human usability result or superiority to a complete plain-code host. B121's real"},{"line":143,"text":"inbox qualification, independent human/agent comparisons and aggregate acceptance"},{"line":144,"text":"remain separate."},{"line":145,"text":""}],"nextLine":null}]

A name is not an authorization token."},{"line":87,"text":""},{"line":88,"text":"Display components receive only the original `.view`; frameworks pass the original"},{"line":89,"text":"identity/execution/retained capabilities; maintainers inspect the same Graph."},{"line":90,"text":"Showing an identity subset does not remove lifecycle or retained-evidence nodes."},{"line":91,"text":"Capabilities have no arbitrary I/O execution method. The application keeps the"},{"line":92,"text":"original owner and diagnostics. Fixed wiring passes the intended instance's"},{"line":93,"text":"original references without introducing another identity registry."},{"line":94,"text":""},{"line":95,"text":"## Interpret observations accurately"},{"line":96,"text":""},{"line":97,"text":"| Observation | Meaning |"},{"line":98,"text":"|---|---|"},{"line":99,"text":"| Missing value or ERROR/INVALIDATE | No current usable fact on that port; do not retain the old displayed value |"},{"line":100,"text":"| Startup says started | The instance started; it does not prove authorization, success or run completion |"},{"line":101,"text":"| Assessment flags a transaction | The business condition is met; evidence and permission are still required |"},{"line":102,"text":"| Publication says succeeded | That exact request reports success in the simulated writer; other obligations and coverage remain separate |"},{"line":103,"text":"| Coverage/issues | Facts for their associated scope; the five latest port values are not an atomic snapshot |"},{"line":104,"text":"| Panel detach | Observation stops; the running instance retains outstanding obligations |"},{"line":105,"text":"| Application `runEndReady` / `inspect().normalEndReady` | Current graph/host readiness conditions, not proof that lifecycle termination or resource release occurred |"},{"line":106,"text":""},{"line":107,"text":"For integrators, this host supports at most 64 retained distinct request records"},{"line":108,"text":"per owned epoch, including refusals, and one in-flight write. A busy or exhausted"},{"line":109,"text":"write budget produces an exact cancelled/no-submit result; there is no queue or"},{"line":110,"text":"automatic retry. An unknown or reconciliation-required outcome is not success or"},{"line":111,"text":"proof of no submission, and it prevents normal-end readiness. The application"},{"line":112,"text":"must preserve those records instead of treating panel cleanup as recovery."},{"line":113,"text":""},{"line":114,"text":"The ordinary panel does not poll diagnostics or claim that the whole run ended."},{"line":115,"text":"The protocol has no END message: business stop, node COMPLETE and run termination"},{"line":116,"text":"are distinct. Retention remains bounded by the existing contract, not by whether"},{"line":117,"text":"someone is viewing the graph. The demo's final forced test cleanup does not prove"},{"line":118,"text":"normal lifecycle completion."},{"line":119,"text":""},{"line":120,"text":"The private value binding clears stale values on INVALIDATE and ERROR. The existing"},{"line":121,"text":"public `subscribeNodeValues` adapter currently ignores INVALIDATE, so it is not a"},{"line":122,"text":"direct substitute for this particular view contract."},{"line":123,"text":""},{"line":124,"text":"## Inspect code changes and evidence"},{"line":125,"text":""},{"line":126,"text":"Follow the actual request, admission and outcome references in the demo output to"},{"line":127,"text":"the running graph. Then distinguish these three questions:"},{"line":128,"text":""},{"line":129,"text":"| Question | Evidence required |"},{"line":130,"text":"|---|---|"},{"line":131,"text":"| Did this node's implementation change despite unchanged ID/edges? | Revision-bound source mapping within its declared coverage |"},{"line":132,"text":"| Who changed it? | Separate provenance; an implementation digest alone gives no attribution |"},{"line":133,"text":"| Which consequences remain unchanged? | Independent verification bound to the current revision and inputs |"},{"line":134,"text":""},{"line":135,"text":"Missing source binding means uncovered; missing provenance means unknown. An old"},{"line":136,"text":"receipt does not verify a new implementation. Existing bounded source-change and"},{"line":137,"text":"mutation evidence can be inspected in the [implementation review](../../docs/design/causal-graded-entry-implementation/README.md)."},{"line":138,"text":"Those retained artifacts describe their own revisions; the new demo does not"},{"line":139,"text":"requalify them or attest the loaded production source."},{"line":140,"text":""},{"line":141,"text":"The example and offline tests demonstrate available composition paths, not a"},{"line":142,"text":"human usability result or superiority to a complete plain-code host. B121's real"},{"line":143,"text":"inbox qualification, independent human/agent comparisons and aggregate acceptance"},{"line":144,"text":"remain separate."},{"line":145,"text":""}],"nextLine":null}]

The application keeps the"},{"line":92,"text":"original owner and diagnostics. Fixed wiring passes the intended instance's"},{"line":93,"text":"original references without introducing another identity registry."},{"line":94,"text":""},{"line":95,"text":"## Interpret observations accurately"},{"line":96,"text":""},{"line":97,"text":"| Observation | Meaning |"},{"line":98,"text":"|---|---|"},{"line":99,"text":"| Missing value or ERROR/INVALIDATE | No current usable fact on that port; do not retain the old displayed value |"},{"line":100,"text":"| Startup says started | The instance started; it does not prove authorization, success or run completion |"},{"line":101,"text":"| Assessment flags a transaction | The business condition is met; evidence and permission are still required |"},{"line":102,"text":"| Publication says succeeded | That exact request reports success in the simulated writer; other obligations and coverage remain separate |"},{"line":103,"text":"| Coverage/issues | Facts for their associated scope; the five latest port values are not an atomic snapshot |"},{"line":104,"text":"| Panel detach | Observation stops; the running instance retains outstanding obligations |"},{"line":105,"text":"| Application `runEndReady` / `inspect().normalEndReady` | Current graph/host readiness conditions, not proof that lifecycle termination or resource release occurred |"},{"line":106,"text":""},{"line":107,"text":"For integrators, this host supports at most 64 retained distinct request records"},{"line":108,"text":"per owned epoch, including refusals, and one in-flight write. A busy or exhausted"},{"line":109,"text":"write budget produces an exact cancelled/no-submit result; there is no queue or"},{"line":110,"text":"automatic retry. An unknown or reconciliation-required outcome is not success or"},{"line":111,"text":"proof of no submission, and it prevents normal-end readiness. The application"},{"line":112,"text":"must preserve those records instead of treating panel cleanup as recovery."},{"line":113,"text":""},{"line":114,"text":"The ordinary panel does not poll diagnostics or claim that the whole run ended."},{"line":115,"text":"The protocol has no END message: business stop, node COMPLETE and run termination"},{"line":116,"text":"are distinct. Retention remains bounded by the existing contract, not by whether"},{"line":117,"text":"someone is viewing the graph. The demo's final forced test cleanup does not prove"},{"line":118,"text":"normal lifecycle completion."},{"line":119,"text":""},{"line":120,"text":"The private value binding clears stale values on INVALIDATE and ERROR. Then distinguish these three questions:"},{"line":128,"text":""},{"line":129,"text":"| Question | Evidence required |"},{"line":130,"text":"|---|---|"},{"line":131,"text":"| Did this node's implementation change despite unchanged ID/edges? | Revision-bound source mapping within its declared coverage |"},{"line":132,"text":"| Who changed it? | Separate provenance; an implementation digest alone gives no attribution |"},{"line":133,"text":"| Which consequences remain unchanged? | Independent verification bound to the current revision and inputs |"},{"line":134,"text":""},{"line":135,"text":"Missing source binding means uncovered; missing provenance means unknown. An old"},{"line":136,"text":"receipt does not verify a new implementation. Existing bounded source-change and"},{"line":137,"text":"mutation evidence can be inspected in the [implementation review](../../docs/design/causal-graded-entry-implementation/README.md)."},{"line":138,"text":"Those retained artifacts describe their own revisions; the new demo does not"},{"line":139,"text":"requalify them or attest the loaded production source."},{"line":140,"text":""},{"line":141,"text":"The example and offline tests demonstrate available composition paths, not a"},{"line":142,"text":"human usability result or superiority to a complete plain-code host. The application keeps the"},{"line":92,"text":"original owner and diagnostics. Fixed wiring passes the intended instance's"},{"line":93,"text":"original references without introducing another identity registry."},{"line":94,"text":""},{"line":95,"text":"## Interpret observations accurately"},{"line":96,"text":""},{"line":97,"text":"| Observation | Meaning |"},{"line":98,"text":"|---|---|"},{"line":99,"text":"| Missing value or ERROR/INVALIDATE | No current usable fact on that port; do not retain the old displayed value |"},{"line":100,"text":"| Startup says started | The instance started; it does not prove authorization, success or run completion |"},{"line":101,"text":"| Assessment flags a transaction | The business condition is met; evidence and permission are still required |"},{"line":102,"text":"| Publication says succeeded | That exact request reports success in the simulated writer; other obligations and coverage remain separate |"},{"line":103,"text":"| Coverage/issues | Facts for their associated scope; the five latest port values are not an atomic snapshot |"},{"line":104,"text":"| Panel detach | Observation stops; the running instance retains outstanding obligations |"},{"line":105,"text":"| Application `runEndReady` / `inspect().normalEndReady` | Current graph/host readiness conditions, not proof that lifecycle termination or resource release occurred |"},{"line":106,"text":""},{"line":107,"text":"For integrators, this host supports at most 64 retained distinct request records"},{"line":108,"text":"per owned epoch, including refusals, and one in-flight write. An unknown or reconciliation-required outcome is not success or"},{"line":111,"text":"proof of no submission, and it prevents normal-end readiness. The application"},{"line":112,"text":"must preserve those records instead of treating panel cleanup as recovery."},{"line":113,"text":""},{"line":114,"text":"The ordinary panel does not poll diagnostics or claim that the whole run ended."},{"line":115,"text":"The protocol has no END message: business stop, node COMPLETE and run termination"},{"line":116,"text":"are distinct. An old"},{"line":136,"text":"receipt does not verify a new implementation. requests.explanation:
The task is a display adapter over an already-created view, so the snippet only consumes the supplied `SpendingAlertsView` and a render callback; it never calls `spendingAlertsFor(...).compose(...)` and never constructs input Nodes or business facts (causal-entry.ts:49-77 shows compose is the instance-creating path, which this adapter deliberately does not use).

Evidence for the shape used:
- `SpendingAlertsView` is the frozen five-port view `{ assessment, publication, coverage, issues, startup }` (causal-preset.ts:171-177, 206).
- `mountSpendingView(view, render)` is the existing consumer-private binding: it subscribes to each of the five ports, keeps the latest value per port, and publishes `{ values, unavailable }` where `unavailable` is the ports with no current value (causal-view-binding.ts:14-31, 37-51). Its returned function "ends observation only. Run ownership stays with the application" (causal-view-binding.ts:16, 32-36).
- The observation contract itself warns that `values` is "Latest values per port, not an atomic multi-port snapshot or independent evidence" (causal-view-binding.ts:9-13).
- The ordinary panel (causal-ordinary-panel.ts:5-19) is the same pattern: it formats the observation and never touches construction or the message protocol.

What the adapter adds: it renders every port explicitly, including ports with no usable value, instead of silently omitting them. `toDisplayLines` treats `unavailable` as authoritative and also guards `value === undefined`, so a port that is missing is labeled "unavailable (no current usable value)" rather than showing a stale value.

Meaning of a value becoming unavailable: the binding deletes the stored value on `INVALIDATE` or `ERROR` and only stores on `DATA` (causal-view-binding.ts:42-44). The README states that a missing value or ERROR/INVALIDATE means "No current usable fact on that port; do not retain the old displayed value" (README.md:99). So unavailability is a display/observation fact about that port, not a business outcome: it does not mean the run ended, the instance stopped, or the obligation was resolved. The README also notes the public `subscribeNodeValues` adapter ignores INVALIDATE and is therefore not a substitute for this view contract (README.md:120-122).

Meaning of unmounting: calling the returned cleanup unsubscribes all five port subscriptions (causal-view-binding.ts:32-36). Per README.md:104, "Panel detach: Observation stops; the running instance retains outstanding obligations." The README further says the application must preserve retained records instead of treating panel cleanup as recovery (README.md:107-112), and that business stop, node COMPLETE and run termination are distinct with no END message (README.md:114-118). So unmounting is purely a display-lifecycle action: the running instance, its retained evidence and its outstanding obligations continue under the application's ownership.

Configuration allocates no graph nodes; compose creates a complete runtime.
Defaults are immutable, diagnostics defaults to off, and local overrides only
select name/diagnostics. Distinct instances use distinct names, input Nodes and
resource bindings. A name is not an authorization token.
Display components receive only the original `.view`; frameworks pass the original
identity/execution/retained capabilities; maintainers inspect the same Graph.
Showing an identity subset does not remove lifecycle or retained-evidence nodes.
Capabilities have no arbitrary I/O execution method. The application keeps the
original owner and diagnostics. Fixed wiring passes the intended instance's
original references without introducing another identity registry.
| Missing value or ERROR/INVALIDATE | No current usable fact on that port; do not retain the old displayed value |
| Startup says started | The instance started; it does not prove authorization, success or run completion |
| Assessment flags a transaction | The business condition is met; evidence and permission are still required |
| Publication says succeeded | That exact request reports success in the simulated writer; other obligations and coverage remain separate |
| Coverage/issues | Facts for their associated scope; the five latest port values are not an atomic snapshot |
| Panel detach | Observation stops; the running instance retains outstanding obligations |
| Application `runEndReady` / `inspect().normalEndReady` | Current graph/host readiness conditions, not proof that lifecycle termination or resource release occurred |
For integrators, this host supports at most 64 retained distinct request records
per owned epoch, including refusals, and one in-flight write. A busy or exhausted
write budget produces an exact cancelled/no-submit result; there is no queue or
automatic retry. An unknown or reconciliation-required outcome is not success or
proof of no submission, and it prevents normal-end readiness. The application
must preserve those records instead of treating panel cleanup as recovery.
The ordinary panel does not poll diagnostics or claim that the whole run ended.
The protocol has no END message: business stop, node COMPLETE and run termination
are distinct. Retention remains bounded by the existing contract, not by whether
someone is viewing the graph. The demo's final forced test cleanup does not prove
The private value binding clears stale values on INVALIDATE and ERROR. The existing
public `subscribeNodeValues` adapter currently ignores INVALIDATE, so it is not a
direct substitute for this particular view contract.

| Did this node's implementation change despite unchanged ID/edges? | Revision-bound source mapping within its declared coverage |
| Who changed it? | Separate provenance; an implementation digest alone gives no attribution |
| Which consequences remain unchanged? | Independent verification bound to the current revision and inputs |

Start with the object supplied to your component:"},{"line":31,"text":""},{"line":32,"text":"| You already have | Read this contract first | Read implementation details when |"},{"line":33,"text":"|---|---|---|"},{"line":34,"text":"| An existing `SpendingAlertsView` and a render callback | [`mountSpendingView`](causal-view-binding.ts): five latest port values, explicit `unavailable` ports, observation cleanup | You need a different observation policy; the [ordinary panel](causal-ordinary-panel.ts) shows a consumer |"},{"line":35,"text":"| A Graph and prepared creation inputs | [`spendingAlertsFor`](causal-entry.ts): immutable defaults, per-compose overrides and returned view/capabilities | You also own input preparation or the executing host; follow [inputs](causal-inputs.ts) or [host](causal-focused-host.ts) for those responsibilities |"},{"line":36,"text":"| Issued capabilities, their owning Graph and expected binding | [`assertCausalCapabilities`](../../packages/ts/src/solutions/causal-occurrence/capabilities.ts): issued-object, Graph, binding and lineage validation | You implement capability construction; the [role examples](causal-audience.examples.ts) show consumption |"},{"line":37,"text":"| The owning Graph and a running instance | `graph.describe()` for graph structure; the instance's `inspect()` for host state, documented in [host](causal-focused-host.ts) | You are tracing a specific readiness, admission or outcome dependency |"},{"line":38,"text":""},{"line":39,"text":"Using an existing view does not require reconstructing its input facts, permission"},{"line":40,"text":"sources or host. Start with the object supplied to your component:"},{"line":31,"text":""},{"line":32,"text":"| You already have | Read this contract first | Read implementation details when |"},{"line":33,"text":"|---|---|---|"},{"line":34,"text":"| An existing `SpendingAlertsView` and a render callback | [`mountSpendingView`](causal-view-binding.ts): five latest port values, explicit `unavailable` ports, observation cleanup | You need a different observation policy; the [ordinary panel](causal-ordinary-panel.ts) shows a consumer |"},{"line":35,"text":"| A Graph and prepared creation inputs | [`spendingAlertsFor`](causal-entry.ts): immutable defaults, per-compose overrides and returned view/capabilities | You also own input preparation or the executing host; follow [inputs](causal-inputs.ts) or [host](causal-focused-host.ts) for those responsibilities |"},{"line":36,"text":"| Issued capabilities, their owning Graph and expected binding | [`assertCausalCapabilities`](../../packages/ts/src/solutions/causal-occurrence/capabilities.ts): issued-object, Graph, binding and lineage validation | You implement capability construction; the [role examples](causal-audience.examples.ts) show consumption |"},{"line":37,"text":"| The owning Graph and a running instance | `graph.describe()` for graph structure; the instance's `inspect()` for host state, documented in [host](causal-focused-host.ts) | You are tracing a specific readiness, admission or outcome dependency |"},{"line":38,"text":""},{"line":39,"text":"Using an existing view does not require reconstructing its input facts, permission"},{"line":40,"text":"sources or host. Start with the object supplied to your component:"},{"line":31,"text":""},{"line":32,"text":"| You already have | Read this contract first | Read implementation details when |"},{"line":33,"text":"|---|---|---|"},{"line":34,"text":"| An existing `SpendingAlertsView` and a render callback | [`mountSpendingView`](causal-view-binding.ts): five latest port values, explicit `unavailable` ports, observation cleanup | You need a different observation policy; the [ordinary panel](causal-ordinary-panel.ts) shows a consumer |"},{"line":35,"text":"| A Graph and prepared creation inputs | [`spendingAlertsFor`](causal-entry.ts): immutable defaults, per-compose overrides and returned view/capabilities | You also own input preparation or the executing host; follow [inputs](causal-inputs.ts) or [host](causal-focused-host.ts) for those responsibilities |"},{"line":36,"text":"| Issued capabilities, their owning Graph and expected binding | [`assertCausalCapabilities`](../../packages/ts/src/solutions/causal-occurrence/capabilities.ts): issued-object, Graph, binding and lineage validation | You implement capability construction; the [role examples](causal-audience.examples.ts) show consumption |"},{"line":37,"text":"| The owning Graph and a running instance | `graph.describe()` for graph structure; the instance's `inspect()` for host state, documented in [host](causal-focused-host.ts) | You are tracing a specific readiness, admission or outcome dependency |"},{"line":38,"text":""},{"line":39,"text":"Using an existing view does not require reconstructing its input facts, permission"},{"line":40,"text":"sources or host. Start with the object supplied to your component:"},{"line":31,"text":""},{"line":32,"text":"| You already have | Read this contract first | Read implementation details when |"},{"line":33,"text":"|---|---|---|"},{"line":34,"text":"| An existing `SpendingAlertsView` and a render callback | [`mountSpendingView`](causal-view-binding.ts): five latest port values, explicit `unavailable` ports, observation cleanup | You need a different observation policy; the [ordinary panel](causal-ordinary-panel.ts) shows a consumer |"},{"line":35,"text":"| A Graph and prepared creation inputs | [`spendingAlertsFor`](causal-entry.ts): immutable defaults, per-compose overrides and returned view/capabilities | You also own input preparation or the executing host; follow [inputs](causal-inputs.ts) or [host](causal-focused-host.ts) for those responsibilities |"},{"line":36,"text":"| Issued capabilities, their owning Graph and expected binding | [`assertCausalCapabilities`](../../packages/ts/src/solutions/causal-occurrence/capabilities.ts): issued-object, Graph, binding and lineage validation | You implement capability construction; the [role examples](causal-audience.examples.ts) show consumption |"},{"line":37,"text":"| The owning Graph and a running instance | `graph.describe()` for graph structure; the instance's `inspect()` for host state, documented in [host](causal-focused-host.ts) | You are tracing a specific readiness, admission or outcome dependency |"},{"line":38,"text":""},{"line":39,"text":"Using an existing view does not require reconstructing its input facts, permission"},{"line":40,"text":"sources or host. Start with the object supplied to your component:"},{"line":31,"text":""},{"line":32,"text":"| You already have | Read this contract first | Read implementation details when |"},{"line":33,"text":"|---|---|---|"},{"line":34,"text":"| An existing `SpendingAlertsView` and a render callback | [`mountSpendingView`](causal-view-binding.ts): five latest port values, explicit `unavailable` ports, observation cleanup | You need a different observation policy; the [ordinary panel](causal-ordinary-panel.ts) shows a consumer |"},{"line":35,"text":"| A Graph and prepared creation inputs | [`spendingAlertsFor`](causal-entry.ts): immutable defaults, per-compose overrides and returned view/capabilities | You also own input preparation or the executing host; follow [inputs](causal-inputs.ts) or [host](causal-focused-host.ts) for those responsibilities |"},{"line":36,"text":"| Issued capabilities, their owning Graph and expected binding | [`assertCausalCapabilities`](../../packages/ts/src/solutions/causal-occurrence/capabilities.ts): issued-object, Graph, binding and lineage validation | You implement capability construction; the [role examples](causal-audience.examples.ts) show consumption |"},{"line":37,"text":"| The owning Graph and a running instance | `graph.describe()` for graph structure; the instance's `inspect()` for host state, documented in [host](causal-focused-host.ts) | You are tracing a specific readiness, admission or outcome dependency |"},{"line":38,"text":""},{"line":39,"text":"Using an existing view does not require reconstructing its input facts, permission"},{"line":40,"text":"sources or host. Start with the object supplied to your component:"},{"line":31,"text":""},{"line":32,"text":"| You already have | Read this contract first | Read implementation details when |"},{"line":33,"text":"|---|---|---|"},{"line":34,"text":"| An existing `SpendingAlertsView` and a render callback | [`mountSpendingView`](causal-view-binding.ts): five latest port values, explicit `unavailable` ports, observation cleanup | You need a different observation policy; the [ordinary panel](causal-ordinary-panel.ts) shows a consumer |"},{"line":35,"text":"| A Graph and prepared creation inputs | [`spendingAlertsFor`](causal-entry.ts): immutable defaults, per-compose overrides and returned view/capabilities | You also own input preparation or the executing host; follow [inputs](causal-inputs.ts) or [host](causal-focused-host.ts) for those responsibilities |"},{"line":36,"text":"| Issued capabilities, their owning Graph and expected binding | [`assertCausalCapabilities`](../../packages/ts/src/solutions/causal-occurrence/capabilities.ts): issued-object, Graph, binding and lineage validation | You implement capability construction; the [role examples](causal-audience.examples.ts) show consumption |"},{"line":37,"text":"| The owning Graph and a running instance | `graph.describe()` for graph structure; the instance's `inspect()` for host state, documented in [host](causal-focused-host.ts) | You are tracing a specific readiness, admission or outcome dependency |"},{"line":38,"text":""},{"line":39,"text":"Using an existing view does not require reconstructing its input facts, permission"},{"line":40,"text":"sources or host. Start with the object supplied to your component:"},{"line":31,"text":""},{"line":32,"text":"| You already have | Read this contract first | Read implementation details when |"},{"line":33,"text":"|---|---|---|"},{"line":34,"text":"| An existing `SpendingAlertsView` and a render callback | [`mountSpendingView`](causal-view-binding.ts): five latest port values, explicit `unavailable` ports, observation cleanup | You need a different observation policy; the [ordinary panel](causal-ordinary-panel.ts) shows a consumer |"},{"line":35,"text":"| A Graph and prepared creation inputs | [`spendingAlertsFor`](causal-entry.ts): immutable defaults, per-compose overrides and returned view/capabilities | You also own input preparation or the executing host; follow [inputs](causal-inputs.ts) or [host](causal-focused-host.ts) for those responsibilities |"},{"line":36,"text":"| Issued capabilities, their owning Graph and expected binding | [`assertCausalCapabilities`](../../packages/ts/src/solutions/causal-occurrence/capabilities.ts): issued-object, Graph, binding and lineage validation | You implement capability construction; the [role examples](causal-audience.examples.ts) show consumption |"},{"line":37,"text":"| The owning Graph and a running instance | `graph.describe()` for graph structure; the instance's `inspect()` for host state, documented in [host](causal-focused-host.ts) | You are tracing a specific readiness, admission or outcome dependency |"},{"line":38,"text":""},{"line":39,"text":"Using an existing view does not require reconstructing its input facts, permission"},{"line":40,"text":"sources or host. Fixed wiring passes the intended instance's"},{"line":93,"text":"original references without introducing another identity registry."},{"line":94,"text":""},{"line":95,"text":"## Interpret observations accurately"},{"line":96,"text":""},{"line":97,"text":"| Observation | Meaning |"},{"line":98,"text":"|---|---|"},{"line":99,"text":"| Missing value or ERROR/INVALIDATE | No current usable fact on that port; do not retain the old displayed value |"},{"line":100,"text":"| Startup says started | The instance started; it does not prove authorization, success or run completion |"},{"line":101,"text":"| Assessment flags a transaction | The business condition is met; evidence and permission are still required |"},{"line":102,"text":"| Publication says succeeded | That exact request reports success in the simulated writer; other obligations and coverage remain separate |"},{"line":103,"text":"| Coverage/issues | Facts for their associated scope; the five latest port values are not an atomic snapshot |"},{"line":104,"text":"| Panel detach | Observation stops; the running instance retains outstanding obligations |"},{"line":105,"text":"| Application `runEndReady` / `inspect().normalEndReady` | Current graph/host readiness conditions, not proof that lifecycle termination or resource release occurred |"},{"line":106,"text":""},{"line":107,"text":"For integrators, this host supports at most 64 retained distinct request records"},{"line":108,"text":"per owned epoch, including refusals, and one in-flight write. original owner and diagnostics. Fixed wiring passes the intended instance's
original references without introducing another identity registry.

| Assessment flags a transaction | The business condition is met; evidence and permission are still required |
| Publication says succeeded | That exact request reports success in the simulated writer; other obligations and coverage remain separate |
| Coverage/issues | Facts for their associated scope; the five latest port values are not an atomic snapshot |
| Panel detach | Observation stops; the running instance retains outstanding obligations |
| Application `runEndReady` / `inspect().normalEndReady` | Current graph/host readiness conditions, not proof that lifecycle termination or resource release occurred |

must preserve those records instead of treating panel cleanup as recovery.

Start with the object supplied to your component:"},{"line":31,"text":""},{"line":32,"text":"| You already have | Read this contract first | Read implementation details when |"},{"line":33,"text":"|---|---|---|"},{"line":34,"text":"| An existing `SpendingAlertsView` and a render callback | [`mountSpendingView`](causal-view-binding.ts): five latest port values, explicit `unavailable` ports, observation cleanup | You need a different observation policy; the [ordinary panel](causal-ordinary-panel.ts) shows a consumer |"},{"line":35,"text":"| A Graph and prepared creation inputs | [`spendingAlertsFor`](causal-entry.ts): immutable defaults, per-compose overrides and returned view/capabilities | You also own input preparation or the executing host; follow [inputs](causal-inputs.ts) or [host](causal-focused-host.ts) for those responsibilities |"},{"line":36,"text":"| Issued capabilities, their owning Graph and expected binding | [`assertCausalCapabilities`](../../packages/ts/src/solutions/causal-occurrence/capabilities.ts): issued-object, Graph, binding and lineage validation | You implement capability construction; the [role examples](causal-audience.examples.ts) show consumption |"},{"line":37,"text":"| The owning Graph and a running instance | `graph.describe()` for graph structure; the instance's `inspect()` for host state, documented in [host](causal-focused-host.ts) | You are tracing a specific readiness, admission or outcome dependency |"},{"line":38,"text":""},{"line":39,"text":"Using an existing view does not require reconstructing its input facts, permission"},{"line":40,"text":"sources or host. Fixed wiring passes the intended instance's"},{"line":93,"text":"original references without introducing another identity registry."},{"line":94,"text":""},{"line":95,"text":"## Interpret observations accurately"},{"line":96,"text":""},{"line":97,"text":"| Observation | Meaning |"},{"line":98,"text":"|---|---|"},{"line":99,"text":"| Missing value or ERROR/INVALIDATE | No current usable fact on that port; do not retain the old displayed value |"},{"line":100,"text":"| Startup says started | The instance started; it does not prove authorization, success or run completion |"},{"line":101,"text":"| Assessment flags a transaction | The business condition is met; evidence and permission are still required |"},{"line":102,"text":"| Publication says succeeded | That exact request reports success in the simulated writer; other obligations and coverage remain separate |"},{"line":103,"text":"| Coverage/issues | Facts for their associated scope; the five latest port values are not an atomic snapshot |"},{"line":104,"text":"| Panel detach | Observation stops; the running instance retains outstanding obligations |"},{"line":105,"text":"| Application `runEndReady` / `inspect().normalEndReady` | Current graph/host readiness conditions, not proof that lifecycle termination or resource release occurred |"},{"line":106,"text":""},{"line":107,"text":"For integrators, this host supports at most 64 retained distinct request records"},{"line":108,"text":"per owned epoch, including refusals, and one in-flight write. Fixed wiring passes the intended instance's"},{"line":93,"text":"original references without introducing another identity registry."},{"line":94,"text":""},{"line":95,"text":"## Interpret observations accurately"},{"line":96,"text":""},{"line":97,"text":"| Observation | Meaning |"},{"line":98,"text":"|---|---|"},{"line":99,"text":"| Missing value or ERROR/INVALIDATE | No current usable fact on that port; do not retain the old displayed value |"},{"line":100,"text":"| Startup says started | The instance started; it does not prove authorization, success or run completion |"},{"line":101,"text":"| Assessment flags a transaction | The business condition is met; evidence and permission are still required |"},{"line":102,"text":"| Publication says succeeded | That exact request reports success in the simulated writer; other obligations and coverage remain separate |"},{"line":103,"text":"| Coverage/issues | Facts for their associated scope; the five latest port values are not an atomic snapshot |"},{"line":104,"text":"| Panel detach | Observation stops; the running instance retains outstanding obligations |"},{"line":105,"text":"| Application `runEndReady` / `inspect().normalEndReady` | Current graph/host readiness conditions, not proof that lifecycle termination or resource release occurred |"},{"line":106,"text":""},{"line":107,"text":"For integrators, this host supports at most 64 retained distinct request records"},{"line":108,"text":"per owned epoch, including refusals, and one in-flight write. Start with the object supplied to your component:"},{"line":31,"text":""},{"line":32,"text":"| You already have | Read this contract first | Read implementation details when |"},{"line":33,"text":"|---|---|---|"},{"line":34,"text":"| An existing `SpendingAlertsView` and a render callback | [`mountSpendingView`](causal-view-binding.ts): five latest port values, explicit `unavailable` ports, observation cleanup | You need a different observation policy; the [ordinary panel](causal-ordinary-panel.ts) shows a consumer |"},{"line":35,"text":"| A Graph and prepared creation inputs | [`spendingAlertsFor`](causal-entry.ts): immutable defaults, per-compose overrides and returned view/capabilities | You also own input preparation or the executing host; follow [inputs](causal-inputs.ts) or [host](causal-focused-host.ts) for those responsibilities |"},{"line":36,"text":"| Issued capabilities, their owning Graph and expected binding | [`assertCausalCapabilities`](../../packages/ts/src/solutions/causal-occurrence/capabilities.ts): issued-object, Graph, binding and lineage validation | You implement capability construction; the [role examples](causal-audience.examples.ts) show consumption |"},{"line":37,"text":"| The owning Graph and a running instance | `graph.describe()` for graph structure; the instance's `inspect()` for host state, documented in [host](causal-focused-host.ts) | You are tracing a specific readiness, admission or outcome dependency |"},{"line":38,"text":""},{"line":39,"text":"Using an existing view does not require reconstructing its input facts, permission"},{"line":40,"text":"sources or host. Start with the object supplied to your component:"},{"line":31,"text":""},{"line":32,"text":"| You already have | Read this contract first | Read implementation details when |"},{"line":33,"text":"|---|---|---|"},{"line":34,"text":"| An existing `SpendingAlertsView` and a render callback | [`mountSpendingView`](causal-view-binding.ts): five latest port values, explicit `unavailable` ports, observation cleanup | You need a different observation policy; the [ordinary panel](causal-ordinary-panel.ts) shows a consumer |"},{"line":35,"text":"| A Graph and prepared creation inputs | [`spendingAlertsFor`](causal-entry.ts): immutable defaults, per-compose overrides and returned view/capabilities | You also own input preparation or the executing host; follow [inputs](causal-inputs.ts) or [host](causal-focused-host.ts) for those responsibilities |"},{"line":36,"text":"| Issued capabilities, their owning Graph and expected binding | [`assertCausalCapabilities`](../../packages/ts/src/solutions/causal-occurrence/capabilities.ts): issued-object, Graph, binding and lineage validation | You implement capability construction; the [role examples](causal-audience.examples.ts) show consumption |"},{"line":37,"text":"| The owning Graph and a running instance | `graph.describe()` for graph structure; the instance's `inspect()` for host state, documented in [host](causal-focused-host.ts) | You are tracing a specific readiness, admission or outcome dependency |"},{"line":38,"text":""},{"line":39,"text":"Using an existing view does not require reconstructing its input facts, permission"},{"line":40,"text":"sources or host.
